question: Should memory-lancedb autoCapture reject OpenClaw external-content wrappers by default, or should this be exposed as a new captureFilter configuration option?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix defines a security boundary and may add new config surface, so automation should not choose the permanent product policy.

options.title: Reject Wrappers By Default
options.body: Treat EXTERNAL_UNTRUSTED_CONTENT blocks as ineligible for autoCapture before trigger matching and add regression coverage for wrapped web, browser, and tool content.

options.title: Add captureFilter Config
options.body: Implement the proposed excludeWrapped option with schema, manifest, docs, and upgrade-safe default behavior.

options.title: Fold Into Provenance Design
options.body: Keep this narrow issue open under the broader memory trust/provenance work and avoid adding config until that contract is chosen.

recommendation.title: Reject Wrappers By Default
recommendation.body: Treat EXTERNAL_UNTRUSTED_CONTENT blocks as ineligible for autoCapture before trigger matching and add regression coverage for wrapped web, browser, and tool content.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses external-content security markers and memory persistence behavior, and vincentkoc is the strongest routing signal for that boundary from the inspected history.
